description: The image shows a wide, continuous roadway with no visible pedestrian sidewalk on either side; the right edge appears to be a curb with a landscaped strip (low shrubs/flower beds) and trees providing some greenery and shade. Traffic is separated from the landscaped area only by the curb/edge, with multiple lanes and no physical pedestrian barriers, and the street lighting appears limited/unclear in this view. There are no clearly visible curb ramps, crosswalks, or other accessibility features, and the main pedestrian comfort/safety elements are the landscaping and tree canopy rather than dedicated walking space.
